comment: BASELINE B3 — single-root but POLICY-BOUND. Identical to rp-a in every check family (identity method/assurance/validity window, scope, chain binding, embedded validation material, revocation, algorithm profile, broker policy) EXCEPT that it commits to ONE issuer pair. This isolates the federation variable: any difference between V-MR(rp-a) and B3 is attributable to root count alone, not to policy-engine depth. Added 2026-07-23 in response to the referee finding that B1/B2 conflate 'single-root' with 'no policy layer'.
